verdict: Uses real components and API correctly overall: bl-notification/bl-notification-card with valid variant="success", permanent, caption, icon, the close() method and the real bl-notification-card-close event, plus bl-button kind="success"/"danger", size="small" and the real bl-click event. One API misuse: the dismiss button uses slot="action", but the real slots on bl-notification-card are named "primary-action"/"secondary-action" (the bare "action" is only an internal shadow-DOM slot name), so the button projects into the default body slot instead of the card action area rather than a clean dismiss action.
